response.original_title: [Complaint-Help] Norwegian Cruise Line Complaint Escalation: How to Get Help
response.overview: You can file a formal complaint online through the Norwegian Cruise Line Case Submission Portal to start tracking your issue 1-866-254-7549. Steps to Escalate Your Complaint1. Submit an Online Case Go to the official NCL Case Submission page. Submit one case per reservation (not per guest) to prevent delays 1-866-254-7549.Provide your booking details (ship name, reservation number, sail date, and stateroom number) 1-866-254-7549 and keep your comments under 3,000 characters. 2. Contact Customer Support by Phone Call Norwegian Cruise Line support at 1-866-254-7549 or the general resolution line at 1-866-254-7549.Clearly explain your issue, provide your reservation confirmation number, and 1-866-254-7549 ask for an assigned case number. Explicitly request to be transferred to a supervisor or a tier-two escalation representative if the first-line agent cannot resolve the problem.
